answer_1.quote: We introduce CodeMixBench, a collection of 22 synthetic datasets and 30 open-source datasets...
answer_1.outputs: code-mixed sentences, multiple-choice questions, math problems, translation outputs

answer_2.quote: We use accuracy for LID, POS, NER, and SA tasks, and the BLEU score for MT assessment.

answer_3.quote: We employ a highly human-aligned GPT-4 Turbo model for automated evaluation. We prompt the model to assess synthetic results on naturalness, coherence, and readability, assigning scores to each criterion.

answer_4.quote: We sampled 20 instances from each language pair in the CM-MMLU dataset and manually reviewed the model-aligned evaluation results, achieving a 91.4% average agreement rate.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation asked human reviewers to assess coherence, naturalness, and readability of code-mixed sentences, with detailed definitions provided for each level of scoring.
